name: plane
description: Plane project-management MCP server, pinned to makeplane/plane-mcp-server@sha256:1feb49a9 (v0.2.11) and run as a hardened rootless container. Credentials come from ~/.plane-mcp/env and the workspace from a per-project .plane-workspace file, so no shell-profile edits are needed; ships deny profiles because 92 of its 177 tools are unusable on Plane Community.
